design_inferences: Eight occupied parking decks use 3.048 m vertical spacing based on GIS floor fields F01-F07 at 10 ft increments and the 8-level count.
GIS R=78 interpreted as a 78 ft roof/parapet datum (23.774 m); this is not a surveyed height and the true meaning of R remains uncertain.
Facade bay rhythm, concrete tone, circulation tower placement, and internal ramp configuration are inferred from the available exterior photo and parking-garage type.
Current Purdue street-level imagery was not directly captured in this build; facade evidence uses the 2010-era SlideShare exterior and current official location/parking references.
